notes: Adds a Cancel option to every translation queue (Blog, Service title/description, Categories) - click the spinning language badge (in the list or the Details popup) on anything stuck 'translating' for hours/days to clear it and free it up to be queued again. Fixes the root cause of those stuck jobs going forward too: if the background queue command ever dies mid-batch, the job used to stay marked 'running' forever with no way to clear it from the panel. No database update needed for this update.
